purpose: Execution constraints that silently invalidate signals. These were absent from the course corpus (ban period: 0 mentions, adj_factor: 0 mentions).

fno_ban_period.what: A stock enters the F&O ban list when open interest crosses 95% of the Market-Wide Position Limit (MWPL).
fno_ban_period.effect: No fresh derivative positions allowed. Existing positions may be squared off, not added to.
fno_ban_period.exit: The ban lifts when open interest falls back below the threshold (commonly cited around 80% of MWPL). Verify the current circular.
fno_ban_period.penalty: Trading fresh positions during the ban can attract a penalty of about 1% of the increased position value, with a minimum around Rs 5,000.
fno_ban_period.rule_for_signals: If the underlying is in the F&O ban list, do NOT emit a derivative signal. Cash-equity signals are unaffected.
fno_ban_period.data_source: NSE publishes fo_secban.csv daily. This must be ingested, not remembered.

stock_level.rule: A stock stuck at the upper circuit cannot be bought; at the lower circuit it cannot be sold.
stock_level.implication: A backtest that fills at the circuit price is wrong. The fill may not exist.
stock_level.signal_rule: No new signal if the stock hit a circuit limit in the last 3 sessions.

index_level.rule: Exchange-wide circuit breakers halt trading for 15 minutes, 30 minutes, or the rest of the day depending on the level and time of hit.
index_level.implication: Intraday strategies must handle a market-wide halt as a hard risk event.

adj_factor.what: A multiplier that restates historical prices onto today's share basis after splits, bonuses, and rights issues.
adj_factor.rule: Always compute returns on adjusted prices. Never stitch unadjusted prices across an action.
adj_factor.why_absent_from_course: The course corpus has zero mentions of adj_factor. This is the single largest source of fake data in Indian equity backtests.
adj_factor.verification: Check that the adjusted series has no single-day return beyond +/-20% for a largecap unless it is a real event.

dividends.price_return_vs_total_return: Price return excludes dividends. Total return includes them.
dividends.rule: State which basis the backtest uses. Mixing them across strategies makes comparison meaningless.
dividends.note: NSEDATA4ME does not apply dividends. Price return only unless you add them.

ex_dates.rule: Do not open a new position on the ex-date expecting the pre-action price. The price adjusts at open.

settlement.equity: T+1 -- securities and funds settle one business day after trade.
settlement.implication: Capital is locked for one day in delivery trades. A daily rotation strategy cannot reuse the same capital every day.
settlement.fno: Mark-to-market daily; final settlement on expiry.

order_mechanics.freeze_quantity: Large orders must be sliced. NSE publishes per-symbol freeze limits; index F&O freeze limits were revised with effect from October 2026. Verify current values.
order_mechanics.spread_rule: Do not emit a signal when bid-ask spread exceeds 0.5% of price.
order_mechanics.market_order_rule: Never model a market order fill at the last traded price. Model it at the far side of the spread plus slippage.

requires: order rate limit around 10 orders per second
retail_algo_framework.applies_to: Order-generating automation routed through a broker.
retail_algo_framework.does_not_apply_to: A signal-only system that never places an order. This project is signal-only, so the framework does not bind it today -- but it binds the moment execution is added.

regulatory.research_analyst_note: Selling or distributing signals to others can bring you under Research Analyst regulation. Personal use and own capital is a different path. Get a lawyer before distributing anything.
